name: Hydrogen Sulfide
state: Colorless Gas (Rotten egg odor at low conc.)
exposure_symptoms: Eye irritation, olfactory paralysis above 100 ppm, pulmonary edema, rapid knockdown > 500 ppm
first_aid: Move to fresh air immediately. Administer 100% oxygen. CPR if breathing stops. Seek emergency medical aid.
ppe: Positive pressure SCBA, chemical splash goggles, butyl rubber gloves, multi-gas detector
handling_storage: Cylinder storage in well-ventilated dedicated shed, gas leak sensors at 5 ppm & 10 ppm alarms.
refinery_context: CDU/VDU overheads, Amine Treating Unit, Sour Water Stripper, Sulfur Recovery Unit (SRU/Claus)

name: Benzene
exposure_symptoms: Dizziness, headache, drowsiness, chronic exposure causes leukemia / bone marrow suppression
first_aid: Remove contaminated clothing, flush skin/eyes with copious water for 15 mins. Do NOT induce vomiting if swallowed.
ppe: Organic vapor cartridge respirator or airline respirator, Viton gloves, flame-resistant coveralls
handling_storage: Bonded and grounded transfer lines, vapor recovery unit, sealed sample loop.
refinery_context: Catalytic Reformer, Reformate Splitter, Benzene Extraction Unit (BEU), Gasoline Blending

name: Sodium Hydroxide
state: White solid or clear viscous liquid solution
exposure_symptoms: Severe chemical burns, deep tissue ulceration, permanent blindness, corrosion of respiratory tract
first_aid: Flush skin and eyes immediately with copious water for at least 30 minutes. Seek immediate emergency medical attention.
ppe: Chemical splash goggles, full face shield, neoprene or PVC apron/suit, rubber boots, heavy-duty neoprene gloves
handling_storage: Store in corrosion-resistant polyethylene, polypropylene, or nickel-lined vessels. Exothermic upon dilution with water.
refinery_context: LPG Merox wash column, kerosene sweetening, crude desalter pH adjustment, Effluent Treatment Plant (ETP) neutralization

name: Hydrofluoric Acid
exposure_symptoms: Delayed excruciating pain, deep penetrating necrosis, systemic calcium depletion leading to cardiac arrest
first_aid: Immediate decontamination: wash with water for 1-2 min, apply 2.5% Calcium Gluconate gel repeatedly with gloved hand, seek emergency hospital care.
ppe: Level A encapsulating suit or HF acid-resistant neoprene suit, positive pressure SCBA, heavy neoprene/butyl gloves
handling_storage: Store in Monel, carbon steel (anhydrous), or Teflon-lined containers. Calcium gluconate antidote kit must be present in unit.
refinery_context: HF Alkylation Unit (producing high-octane alkylate blendstock for motor gasoline)

name: Chlorine
state: Greenish-yellow gas with pungent, suffocating odor
exposure_symptoms: Choking, coughing, severe airway constriction, pulmonary edema, eye lacrimation, chemical burns
first_aid: Evacuate to fresh air upwind immediately. Keep victim warm and resting. Administer oxygen. Do NOT allow victim to walk. Seek immediate medical aid.
ppe: Level A fully encapsulating chemical protective suit, positive pressure SCBA, butyl rubber gloves
handling_storage: Store ton-containers in dedicated chlorine shed with automatic chlorine gas scrubber system, wind direction socks visible.
refinery_context: Raw water intake treatment, Cooling Water System bio-fouling control, Demineralization (DM) plant biocide

name: Triethylene Glycol
exposure_symptoms: Mild eye and skin irritation, headache from heated vapors, low systemic toxicity
first_aid: Flush eyes and skin with water. If inhaled in high concentrations from reboiler vapor, move to fresh air.
ppe: Chemical safety goggles, nitrile gloves, coveralls; vapor respirator if heated mist present
handling_storage: Store in carbon steel or stainless steel tanks with nitrogen blanketing to prevent thermal degradation and organic acid formation.
refinery_context: Offshore process platforms, Natural gas dehydration units (contactor tower & reboiler operating at 200-204°C)

name: Monoethylene Glycol
exposure_symptoms: CNS depression, nausea, vomiting, metabolic acidosis, acute kidney failure from calcium oxalate crystals
first_aid: If swallowed, seek emergency medical care immediately. Antidote is Fomepizole or ethanol. Flush skin and eyes with water.
ppe: Chemical splash goggles, nitrile or butyl gloves, apron
handling_storage: Store in epoxy-coated steel or stainless steel containers away from strong oxidizing agents.
refinery_context: Deepwater subsea wellhead continuous injection for methane gas hydrate inhibition, Petrochemical MEG synthesis

name: Methanol
state: Clear, colorless, volatile liquid with characteristic alcohol odor
exposure_symptoms: Headache, nausea, abdominal pain, visual impairment/snowstorm vision, blindness, metabolic acidosis
first_aid: Medical emergency: move to fresh air, wash skin, do NOT induce vomiting, administer Fomepizole/ethanol antidote under medical supervision.
ppe: Vapor-tight goggles, butyl rubber gloves, flame-resistant clothing, respiratory protection for vapors >200 ppm
handling_storage: Dedicated flammables storage, nitrogen blanketing, explosion-proof electrical equipment Class 1 Div 1.
refinery_context: Upstream wellhead batch hydrate inhibition, MTBE synthesis unit, hydrogen manufacturing unit feedstock

name: Mercury
state: Heavy, silvery liquid metal (volatilizes at ambient temp)
exposure_symptoms: Tremors, emotional instability, memory loss, renal damage, stomatitis, peripheral neuropathy
first_aid: Move to fresh air immediately. Remove contaminated clothing. Seek immediate medical evaluation and chelating therapy.
ppe: Mercury vapor cartridge respirator with end-of-service life indicator (ESLI), nitrile gloves, disposable Tyvek suit
handling_storage: Impermeable non-porous trays, mercury spill kit, dedicated sulfur-impregnated carbon guard beds for natural gas trunklines.
refinery_context: Subsea gas trunkline mercury guard beds, protecting cryogenic brazed aluminum heat exchangers (BAHX) from catastrophic LME

name: Sulfur Dioxide
state: Colorless gas with suffocating, pungent, choking sulfur odor
hazards: Causes Severe Skin Burns and Eye Damage
exposure_symptoms: Burning throat, rhinorrhea, bronchospasm, pulmonary edema, conjunctivitis, dyspnea
first_aid: Evacuate to fresh air upwind immediately. Keep patient warm and quiet. Administer oxygen. Seek urgent medical attention.
ppe: Chemical safety goggles, air-purifying respirator with acid gas cartridges or SCBA for high concentrations, neoprene gloves
handling_storage: Pressure vessel storage, CPCB continuous stack emission monitoring (CEMS), emergency caustic scrubbing unit.
refinery_context: Sulfur Recovery Unit (SRU) Claus tail gas thermal incinerator stack, sour gas flaring, flue gas desulfurization (FGD)

name: Nitrogen
state: Colorless, odorless, inert gas (or cryogenic liquid)
exposure_symptoms: Rapid unconsciousness without warning signs when O2 < 10%, immediate death from cerebral hypoxia
first_aid: Rescue only with positive pressure SCBA! Move victim to fresh air, give oxygen, perform CPR if required.
ppe: SCBA for confined spaces, oxygen gas monitoring detector badge, cryogenic gloves and face shield for LIN handling
handling_storage: Ensure high-volume ventilation; never enter nitrogen-purged tanks or vessels without confined space permit and O2 verification.
refinery_context: Hydrocarbon vessel purging for turnaround/maintenance, tank blanketing, flare header sweep, instrument air backup

name: Hydrogen
state: Colorless, odorless, highly buoyant flammable gas
exposure_symptoms: Asphyxiation in confined high-concentration clouds, invisible burning flame causing severe thermal burns
first_aid: Shut off source of leak if safe to do so. Move victim to fresh air. Treat thermal burns with cold sterile saline dressings.
ppe: Flame-retardant anti-static clothing, thermal imaging camera to detect invisible flames, explosion-proof tools
handling_storage: Vent headers at elevation with flame arrestors, Nelson curve-compliant metallurgy (Alloy steel 2.25Cr-1Mo-V) for high temp/pressure.
refinery_context: Hydrocracking Unit (HCU), Diesel Hydrodesulfurization (DHDS), Hydrogen Generation Unit (HGU steam methane reformer)

name: Ammonia
state: Colorless gas with sharp, intensely pungent irritating odor
exposure_symptoms: Immediate eye lacrimation, severe throat burning, laryngeal edema, chemical pneumonitis, corneal burns
first_aid: Flush eyes and skin immediately with large quantities of water for 30 min. Administer humidified oxygen. Seek emergency care.
ppe: Chemical splash goggles, ammonia cartridge respirator or SCBA, neoprene gloves, full chemical protective suit
handling_storage: Pressurized spherical/bullet tanks, water spray deluge curtain over storage area to absorb airborne vapor releases.
refinery_context: Selective Catalytic Reduction (SCR) DeNOx units on refinery heaters/boilers, CDU atmospheric overhead neutralization

name: Sulfuric Acid
state: Clear, colorless to dark brown oily viscous liquid
hazards: Causes Severe Skin Burns & Serious Eye Damage
exposure_symptoms: Severe charring chemical burns, deep tissue necrosis, permanent corneal opacity, respiratory tract corrosion
first_aid: Wipe excess acid with dry cloth quickly before flushing with massive amounts of water. Seek immediate hospital care.
ppe: Full acid suit (PVC or butyl), chemical splash goggles, full face shield, heavy-duty acid-resistant gloves, rubber boots
handling_storage: Carbon steel containers (for conc. >93%), lead-lined or alloy 20 for dilute acid. Never add water to acid (exothermic boiling).
refinery_context: Sulfuric acid alkylation unit catalyst, Water Treatment Plant ion-exchange resin regeneration, ETP pH control

name: Hydrochloric Acid
state: Clear, colorless to light yellow fuming liquid with pungent odor
hazards: Causes Severe Skin Burns & Eye Damage
exposure_symptoms: Severe eye and skin burns, choking, coughing, pulmonary edema, ulceration of nasal septum
first_aid: Flush skin and eyes with copious water for at least 20 minutes. Move to fresh air. Seek immediate medical attention.
ppe: Acid-resistant rubber/neoprene gloves, chemical splash goggles, face shield, rubber apron, acid vapor respirator
handling_storage: Store in rubber-lined steel, FRP, or PVDF tanks. Fume scrubbing system required for vents.
refinery_context: Upstream well acid stimulation (matrix acidizing), DM water plant cation exchanger regenerant, equipment descaling

name: Liquefied Petroleum Gas
state: Compressed liquefied gas, colorless (ethyl mercaptan odorant added)
exposure_symptoms: Drowsiness, lightheadedness, frostbite on skin contact from flashing liquid, asphyxiation in pits/depressions
first_aid: Shut off leak if possible. Remove victim to fresh air. Immerse frostbitten areas in warm water (40-42°C). Never rub.
ppe: Flame-resistant Nomex coveralls, thermally insulated cryogenic/chemical gloves, safety goggles, gas detector badge
handling_storage: Mounded bullet storage or refrigerated Horton spheres, water deluge cooling systems, gas detectors at 20% LEL.
refinery_context: LPG Recovery Unit, Merox Treating Unit (mercaptan removal), Bottling plant loading gantry, domestic fuel dispatch
